draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments. All results (T1) are on original training labels only; no perturbation condition or robustness criterion was evaluated. The claim about robustness to label noise has no supporting evidence.
